list.title: Releases
list.description: Group entry changes — publish, unpublish, archive — and put them live together, now or at a set time. Add entries from the Entries list or an entry’s editor.
list.namePlaceholder: New release name, e.g. Spring launch

detail.publishConfirmDescription: {count, plural, one {# change goes} other {# changes go}} live together, in one step. This can’t be undone as a whole.
detail.scheduleHint: Pick a time and the release goes live by itself (checked every minute).
detail.entriesDescription: Each entry goes out as it is at publish time — keep editing until then. Add entries from the <link>Entries</link> list.
detail.conflicts: Also in {releases} — whichever goes out last wins.
detail.deleteConfirmDescription: The release is removed. Its entries stay exactly as they are.

addDialog.title: Add to release
addDialog.description: A release applies all its changes at once — when you publish it, or at its scheduled time.

actionOption.publish: {count, plural, one {Publish this entry} other {Publish these entries}}
actionOption.unpublish: {count, plural, one {Unpublish this entry} other {Unpublish these entries}}
actionOption.archive: {count, plural, one {Archive this entry} other {Archive these entries}}

addDialog.added: {count, plural, one {Added # entry} other {Added # entries}} — <link>open release</link>
addDialog.addFailed: Could not add to the release
